label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee/surprise feast for the mayor at day 1, 18:00: preparing 200 fresh loaves and installing eight lanterns in the great hall, while disguising it as a lighting inspection. Baker supplied 44 loaves on credit; freight and builder organized/baked and delivered bread, builder installed lanterns, and innkeeper coordinated funds, delivery, and the mayor's escort. The mayor was deliberately kept unaware of the celebration's purpose.
